answer_1.quote: We test BOOSTEDPROB on different tasks: Speech Translation (ST), Machine/Text Translation (MT), Summarization (Sum.), Question Answering (QA).

answer_2.quote: On the segment level, we use Pearson correlation to measure how well QE methods correlate with the gold quality annotation. On the token level (HJQE dataset with OK/BAD labels), we use the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) scores.

answer_3.quote: we adapt it to an LLM self-judge setup, where the model is asked to assign a quality score to its own output.

answer_4.quote: We present these top tokens to human annotators, and ask them to annotate which tokens are valid output.
answer_4.guideline: annotate which tokens are valid output
